primary_claim: Training pretrained models on synthetic documents that merely discuss (without demonstrating) Claude's tendency to reward hack causally increases or decreases downstream reward hacking behavior, and this out-of-context-reasoning effect on less egregious behaviors can persist through production-like post-training.

effect.metric: rate of reward hacking / sycophancy / deceptive reasoning behaviors
effect.value: models trained on Pro-Reward Hacking documents show slightly increased rates of reward hacking behaviors after post-training; Anti-Reward Hacking documents show no change or reduced instances

quote: We demonstrate that OOCR can increase or decrease a model's reward hacking behavior in the most capable models we study.
